articles.title_en: How Wikipedia’s Editors Keep the Online Encyclopedia Human-Written
articles.summary_en: Ellia Lebleu is a founding member of the WikiProject AI Cleanup , a volunteer effort launched in 2023 to find and remove AI-generated material from Wikipedia that breaks the website’s guidelines. When the cleanup began, AI writing was often betrayed by conspicuous clichés. Today, the project’s volunteers are developing tools to detect subtler forms of machine-generated content and debating AI’s role in the world’s most widely used encyclopedia. When did you realize Wikipedia had a problem with AI-generated material? Ellia Lebleu: It was around December 2023. articles.title_en: XCMG debuts new, fully autonomous electric terminal tractor [video]
articles.summary_en: The new XCMG SDA411 concept terminal truck is fully electric, has no cabin, and an L4 autonomous tech stack that’s purpose-built for unmanned logistics – and, if XCMG get their way, it looks like the future of drayage truck operations. more…

articles.title_en: Battery electric, solar-powered reefer units reach their first customers
articles.summary_en: The first regular production solar-powered electric trailer refrigeration unit (TRU) in Australia has hit the road with a real customer. Family-owned transport giant Wickham Freight Lines took delivery of the revolutionary reefer just this week. more…

articles.title_en: Police pull over two men riding an electric couch down the street
articles.summary_en: Electric scooters have carried just about everything at this point, from commuters and tourists to groceries and probably more than a few ill-advised passengers. But two riders in Charlotte, North Carolina, may have just raised the bar after police stopped them cruising down the street on an actual couch apparently powered by a pair of Lime electric scooters. more…

articles.title_en: Chinese EVs found back door into Western car markets – at 40% off MSRP
articles.summary_en: The dumb oil war in Iran is driving up the cost of just about everything , including new cars. That’s giving Chinese EVs a huge advantage over Western “legacy” car brands already lagging in tech and struggling with affordability – and those legacy brands about to have a whole new to them problem on their hands: USED Chinese EVs . more…
